title: Rav Chama bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 62b, where Rav Nachman explains his words. In Pesikta Rabbati, piska “Anokhi Menachemkhem,” on the verse “And you forgot,” Rabbi Chaggai speaks in the name of R’ Chama bar Abba.[^1]

notes.text: William Davidson Yevamot 62b fully names Rav Chama bar Abba and Rav Nachman. The OYW Pesikta Rabbati text, chapter 33, has Rabbi Chaggai speaking in R’ Chama bar Abba’s name within the section beginning “Anokhi Anokhi.” Its second title is abbreviated; it is retained as R’ here, alongside the heading’s full Rav.
